classification.difficultyReason: Identify radii and diameters, halve diameters, then apply πr² and round to two decimal places. Early formula scaffolds support the procedure; fractional values introduce no new reasoning.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these circles correct to two decimal places.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre dot and radius extending down left, labelled 3 cm below and to the right of the radius.
spec.mathematics: The marked segment is a radius of 3 cm.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre dot and radius extending slightly down right, labelled 6 m above the radius.
spec.mathematics: The marked segment is a radius of 6 m.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre dot and vertical upward radius, labelled 1.5 mm to its right. The source circle is larger than the adjacent a and b circles.
spec.mathematics: The marked segment is a radius of 1.5 mm.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre dot and vertical diameter, labelled 10 km to its right.
spec.mathematics: The diameter is 10 km, so the radius is 5 km.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre dot and radius extending slightly down right, labelled 3.4 cm above the radius.
spec.mathematics: The marked segment is a radius of 3.4 cm.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre dot and upward vertical radius, labelled 1.7 m to its right.
spec.mathematics: The marked segment is a radius of 1.7 m.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre dot and diagonal diameter from upper left to lower right, labelled 12 cm.
spec.mathematics: The diameter is 12 cm, so the radius is 6 cm.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre dot and diameter sloping slightly down from left to right, labelled 13.5 cm above the diameter.
spec.mathematics: The diameter is 13.5 cm, so the radius is exactly 6.75 cm.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre dot and radius extending slightly down right. Its label is a stacked fraction 21 over 11 followed by mm, above the radius.
spec.mathematics: The radius is exactly 21/11 mm; preserve the fraction until the final rounding.
